reasoning: China's youth unemployment (16-24, excluding students) was 16.5% in December 2025. The question asks if it will fall below 15% in any monthly report released by July 31, 2026. Key considerations: (1) The rate has been below 15% before (13.2% in June 2024), showing it's achievable. (2) Seasonal patterns show decline from summer peaks into fall/winter. (3) Current level of 16.5% is moderately elevated but not at recent peaks (18.9% in August 2025). (4) The timeframe covers January-July 2026, including spring and early summer months. (5) Structural challenges persist (real estate downturn, skills mismatch), but the trend from August 2025 (18.9%) to December 2025 (16.5%) shows improvement. (6) If seasonal patterns hold, spring months (Feb-April) could see further decline before summer graduate influx. Given the recent downward trend, seasonal patterns favoring lower rates in early months, and historical precedent of rates below 15%, there's a reasonable probability of achieving sub-15% in at least one monthly report.
